ns2:section.sectionText: Students must register for a Laboratory (AB_), a Discussion (AY_), and a Lecture (AL_). Individuals registering for a Monday Lab Section must register for a Thursday Discussion Section. Individuals registering for a Wednesday Lab Section must register for a Friday Discussion Section. Those registering for a Tuesday Lab Section can register for either a Thursday or Friday Discussion Section. This course is currently restricted to majors and programs for which it is specifically required.
